objects.taxonomy_description: Adult castrated bovine measuring 140-180 cm at withers weighing 400-900 kg. Body massive and muscular with short dense coat in white, brown, black, or pied coloration. Head broad with wide muzzle. Horns curved laterally and upward (if not dehorned). Eyes large and dark with wide field of vision. Ears large and mobile. Neck thick and muscular with prominent dewlap. Body deep-chested with strong back. Legs sturdy with cloven hooves. Tail long with terminal tuft. Inherited mammal traits include endothermy, hair insulation, mammary glands, and four-chambered heart.

objects.taxonomy_description: Asian proboscidean measuring 250-300 cm at shoulder weighing 3000-5000 kg. Body massive with thick wrinkled gray-brown skin and sparse body hair. Head broad with twin-domed skull. Ears relatively small compared to African elephant. Trunk (proboscis) elongated and muscular with single finger-like projection at tip. Tusks present primarily in males, shorter than African species. Body barrel-shaped with arched back. Legs pillar-like with five toenails on forefeet. Tail long with terminal tuft. Inherited mammal traits include endothermy, sparse hair, mammary glands, and four-chambered heart.

Body_and_Plumage: Massive body with extraordinarily tall, immense proportions at the shoulder.
Thick wrinkled gray-brown skin with sparse body hair.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Pillar-like legs with five toenails on forefeet.

objects.taxonomy_description: Bowed stringed instrument with a curved wooden body approximately 35 cm long. Body has an hourglass shape with C-bouts (inward curves) on each side. Top plate (soundboard) is spruce with two f-shaped sound holes. Back plate is maple with a distinctive flame pattern. Four strings (G, D, A, E) run from a tailpiece at the base over a bridge to tuning pegs in the scroll. Neck extends from the body to a carved scroll at the top. Fingerboard is ebony (black). Varnish finish is amber, reddish-brown, or golden. Chin rest is attached at the lower left. Bow is a wooden stick with horsehair.
